_meta.purpose: Item exclusion / redundancy groups. Owning any item in a group makes the others redundant (or, in some cases, hard-blocked by Riot's inventory rules). Used by item_advisor.is_redundant() and the SR build renderer to prevent suggesting a 2nd item that adds zero functional value.

categories.hard_riot_rules: Riot's engine refuses to let you carry both (e.g. lifeline passives, multiple boots, multiple Tear-built items)
categories.functional_overlap: Allowed by engine but provides no gain (e.g. two armor-pen legendaries, two anti-heal sources)

boots.rule: Inventory allows exactly 1 pair of boots. Picking one excludes all other boots.

lifeline_passive.rule: Riot enforces: only 1 item with the 'Lifeline' passive can be equipped. Hexdrinker is omitted here because lifeline_upgrade allows Hexdrinker → Maw upgrade chain.

tear_built.rule: Riot rule: only 1 Tear-built item per inventory (each consumes the Tear stack mechanic).

ad_armor_pen_legendary.rule: Both upgrade from Last Whisper and stack the same 'percent armor pen' bucket. Owning one makes the other a wasted slot for AD carries.

ap_magic_pen_legendary.rule: All three give magic pen with diminishing returns. Most champs only need one.

antiheal_ad_components.rule: Anti-heal effect doesn't stack across sources — pick the one that fits your slot priority.

antiheal_ap.rule: Anti-heal doesn't stack — Cryptbloom and Morellonomicon each provide it; one is enough.

antiheal_tank.rule: Bramble is a Thornmail component; once Thornmail is built, Bramble is consumed (upgrade allowed).

antiheal_ad_path.rule: Executioner's upgrades to Mortal Reminder; both share grievous wounds, only one needed.

antiheal_ap_path.rule: Oblivion Orb upgrades to Morellonomicon (and Cryptbloom uses an Oblivion Orb); only one anti-heal AP item needed.

tear_path_ad.rule: Tear→Manamune→Muramana is the AD upgrade chain.

tear_path_ap.rule: Tear→Archangel's Staff→Seraph's Embrace is the AP upgrade chain.

lifeline_upgrade.rule: Hexdrinker → Maw of Malmortius is the upgrade path; both are 'Lifeline' items.

stopwatch_upgrade.rule: Stopwatch upgrades to Zhonya's Hourglass (or Seeker's Armguard intermediate). Only 1 active.

qss_active.rule: QSS-style cleanse actives — only one can be on cooldown at a time effectively, and game caps duplicate uniques.

stopwatch_active.rule: Riot rule: only 1 Stopwatch-derived active item.

doran_blade.rule: Stacking 2x Doran's Blade is rare — typically only 1 starter.

support_quest.rule: Riot rule: only 1 support quest item per inventory.

tear_to_archangel_paths.rule: Archangel's and Seraph's are AP path; Manamune/Muramana are AD path. Owning either AP variant makes AD variant redundant and vice versa (and Tear is a component of all four).

lethality_collector.rule: The Collector and Edge of Night both build from Serrated Dirk; their lethality + base AD overlap is partly redundant. Most assassins pick one as the lethality core.
